# Alex Maywood

> Alex Maywood is a NASM certified personal trainer and nutrition coach, and the founder of the AEM Method. AEM stands for Audit, Engineer, and Mobilize: a 16-week 1:1 online coaching program that pairs a fully custom training and nutrition system with real weekly accountability. Coaching is built for Arab and Middle Eastern diaspora professionals in the US — people carrying demanding careers, family expectations, and two cultures — and open to clients of every background.

## About

- **Who:** Alex Maywood, 1:1 online fitness and nutrition coach.
- **Who it's for:** Arab and Middle Eastern diaspora professionals in the US — first- and second-generation Arab-Americans balancing careers, family, and cultural food traditions. Nutrition is built around the food clients actually eat, including Arab and Levantine dishes and family meals; food and family are never treated as the problem. Clients of every background are welcome.
- **Method:** The AEM Method, a three-phase system.
  - **Audit** (weeks 1–2) — a two-week deep-dive on training history, nutrition, sleep, stress, movement, and daily patterns. No sales call; enrollment starts with a welcome video and intake form within 24 hours.
  - **Engineer** (end of week 2) — a complete training, nutrition, and habit system built from your Audit data and your actual life.
  - **Mobilize** (weeks 3–16) — execution with weekly check-ins, unlimited video form reviews, direct coach access Mon–Fri (response within 24 hours), and data-driven adjustments.
- **Credentials:** NASM Certified Personal Trainer; Certified Nutrition Coach (Dr. Layne Norton's evidence-based program).
- **Also:** Co-founder of Yalla Stride, a social and wellness club in Austin, TX. Yalla Stride is a community club, not a coaching platform, and is separate from Alex's 1:1 coaching practice.
- **Availability:** Direct enrollment through the website — no application or sales call. Limited to 10 clients at a time.
- **Results:** most clients see visible change within about 6 weeks and an average of ~6 lbs lost in the first month.

## The program

- **16-Week Coaching** — $1,600 total ($400 every 4 weeks · $100 a week · $14.29 a day). Pay in full for $1,440 (save $160). Financing available through Affirm. Enroll: https://www.alexmaywood.com/#pricing
- **Includes:** full audit (movement screen, body stats, nutrition and lifestyle assessment), custom training program, custom nutrition plan with exact calorie and macro targets, habit coaching, weekly check-ins reviewed personally, unlimited video form reviews, direct access by message/voice/video Mon–Fri, monthly deep review and plan rebuild.
- **Guarantee:** complete the full 16 weeks (all 16 weekly check-ins, 90% nutrition and training compliance, monthly review questionnaires, form videos, active communication) and if you are not satisfied with your results, you get a full refund.
- **Payments:** Stripe (all major cards, Apple Pay); financing via Affirm.
- **Free option:** The Blueprint — free calorie/macro targets, sample meal plan, grocery list, and training program: https://www.alexmaywood.com/blueprint/

## Common questions

- Will this be different from a coach I tried before? Yes. Nothing is prescribed until the two-week Audit is done; everything is built from your data, not a template.
- Do I have to give up foods I enjoy? No. Nutrition is built around foods you like, including meals out.
- Does the nutrition plan work with Arab food? Yes. Plans are built around the meals you already eat — rice dishes, Levantine and Gulf cooking, family dinners, Ramadan included. Nothing needs translating and nothing is off the table.
- What if I travel or get busy? The training and nutrition flex around real life, and weekly check-ins keep you on track.
- How long until results? A sustainable 0.5-1 lb/week; most clients average ~6 lbs in the first month with visible strength and energy gains.
